title: Boundless Necromancer
altTitles: I Alone Level Up Through My Traits
I Alone Grow Infinitely Through My Traits
俺だけチート特性で無限成長
นักล่าไร้ลิมิต
description: Han Seong-yun dreamed of becoming a Hunter after losing his parents during a Dungeon Break, but despite years of training, his attributes never improved. His life changes when he is selected by the mysterious Tower of Trials. Given the choice of difficulty, he chooses the highest possible level and enters a world where monsters, powerful enemies, and deadly trials await. With a unique ability to continuously develop his traits, Seong-yun begins his journey toward becoming an unstoppable Hunter.
author: Fleecy Cloud / Shyatan
